# Spam Message Classifier

Classify labeled synthetic messages as spam or non-spam.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Text vectorization
- [ ] TF-IDF
- [ ] Naive Bayes
- [ ] Logistic regression
- [ ] Class imbalance analysis
- [ ] Precision, recall and false-positive investigation

Use a synthetic or properly licensed dataset. Keep training, selection, and final evaluation separate. Document setup, package versions, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.
